Three identities worth remembering

The mass-energy relation is usually written as follows.

E=mc2E = mc^2E=mc2

The second identity gives the integral of a square over the unit interval.

∫01x2dx=13\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}

MathJax renders the same relation twice, once for people and once for screen readers.

a+b=b+aa+b

The third line is the commutativity of addition, which needs no annotation at all.
